title: Scheduling Logic for Local Notifications
hints: Build `DateComponents` with hour/minute and optionally weekday or day.
Use `.strict` so day 31 skips shorter months.
jsBridge: `UNCalendarNotificationTrigger` fires at the next date matching some `DateComponents`, like a cron expression for local notifications. The web has no reliable scheduled-notification equivalent.

compass.q: Scheduling a notification for 9:00 every weekday on the web needs a push server. What can iOS do locally?
The user changes time zone: does a calendar trigger fire at 9:00 local in the new zone?
Calendar trigger vs time-interval trigger vs location trigger: which for a medication reminder?
iOS limits pending local notifications (64). How do you schedule a year of reminders?
